{{Quote|Go get him.|Voort saBinring to Turman Durra, regarding the salesman|<ref name="MK" /> }}
The '''salesman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] that worked on the [[Sageoval's Decom Mission Transport Yards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, visited the yard and purchased two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] starfighters from the salesman.<ref name="MK" />

==Personality and traits==
The salesman was a rotund Besalisk that like to dress in an expensive suit and a ruffled silk bib.<ref name="MK" />

==Equipment==
His upper left arm and lower right arm had been replaced with old-fashioned mechanical prosthetics.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The salesman appeared in the [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="MK" />
